At the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''Human dancer''' was often seen hanging around in the [[Officers' Club]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In that lounge, [[Gender/Legends|he]] often occupied the center of the stage, dancing to the sound of a band's music before an audience of members of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].
